articles.title: Trump Jokes About Suing Warsh if He Doesn’t Lower Interest Rates
articles.mainIdea: Trump Jokes About Suing Warsh if He Doesn’t Lower Interest Rates
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Trump Jokes About Suing Warsh if He Doesn’t Lower Interest Rates. President Trump joked during a speech Saturday night that he would sue Kevin Warsh, his nominee to chair the Federal Reserve, if he didn’t lower interest rates. Trump was the featured speaker at the Alfalfa Club’s annual black-tie dinner and presented a roast-style speech at the closed-door event. Trump told the group of business leaders and Washington elite that he picked Warsh because he seemed straight from central casting, according to people in the room.
